name: Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure is a free racing game. You're going to need some slippery skills to get behind the wheel of this fishy truck and pull off sharky stunts to score sharky points and make sharky cash. Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure is an endless racing game where you race until you die. After you die that means you can upgrade your wheels, hull, engine, fuel, and bumper with all the cash you made and get back on the track to win some more. See how far you can go and make it to the top of the leaderboard. The best part of this game is when you upgrade your shark-shaped truck all the way to the top of the leaderboard. So,  upgrade your bumper and smash your way through the underwater enemies. Increase your engine and go faster for longer.  Get some new wheels and outmaneuver the competition. This is your game it is all about you.
